· Below SMA100/200 ($262,458/$234,774): Weak long-term trend.

· RSI Trajectory (51.8→41.9) + Entered oversold territory + Downward momentum continues.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-11.2665→681.4217) + Improving diagnosis + Bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $227,700) + Bandwidth at 28.32% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($223,000) + Expected resistance on short-term rallies.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Potential Higher Low formation) + Possibility of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) + Consider buying on break above $223,000, otherwise maintain wait-and-see.
